meta.name: obsidian-skills-integrated
meta.description: 内容创作者与技术写作员在让AI撰写Obsidian笔记时，使用此官方技能可精准处理双链、Callout及Bases数据库语法，一键生成格式零破坏的Canvas画布与专业笔记，彻底解决AI破坏专属格式的痛点。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI生成格式正确的Obsidian笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用AI写Obsidian笔记但总担心格式被破坏
copy.tagline_en: Generate Obsidian notes with correct formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI to write Obsidian notes but worry about broken formatting

howto.what: Claude 会按 Obsidian 专属语法撰写笔记,正确处理双链、Callout、Frontmatter 等格式;还能生成 Canvas 画布文件,并操作 Obsidian 1.9+ 的 Bases 数据库。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或编辑 Obsidian 笔记、生成 Canvas 画布,或操作 Obsidian 数据库(1.9+)时触发。

say.text: 用 json-canvas 生成三国演义人物关系图,按势力分组并用颜色区分。
用 obsidian-bases 创建读书清单数据库,含书名、作者、评分字段。
say.note: 生成可在 Obsidian 1.9+ 打开的数据库。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes Obsidian-flavored Markdown with wikilinks, callouts, and frontmatter; it can also create Canvas files and work with Obsidian Bases databases (1.9+).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit Obsidian notes, generate Canvas diagrams, or operate Obsidian databases (1.9+).

say_en.text: Create a note on AI history with obsidian-markdown, including wikilinks and an INFO callout.
say_en.note: Produces a note in Obsidian-specific format.

say_en.text: Use obsidian-bases to build a reading list database with title, author, and rating fields.
say_en.note: Creates a database openable in Obsidian 1.9+.
